review_candidates.title: Services Engineer

remote_eligibility.note: Generic company words such as 'worldwide' do not count without remote-work context.

review_candidates.description_excerpt: With operations in every corner of the world, our work goes to the cutting-edge of digital transformation and technology. The Services Engineer will provide remote, on-call, shift-based, and onsite technical support for CCS and COM systems operating within the MTS service environment, ensuring system availability and performance in accordance with service level agreements (SLAs). Key responsibilities: Perform remote monitoring, investigation, fault diagnosis, and troubleshooting activities, and undertake site visits when required to support fault rectification, maintenance, testing, commissioning, or operational incidents.
review_candidates.full_review_rule: Open the full record for any possible IT fit or any ambiguity; title alone cannot reject.
